## 2. API Contract Specification (Public & Partner)

- **GET /api/pseo/metro/:slug**: Returns metadata, pricing tiers, and pre-formatted FAQPage schema for the requested metro.
- **POST /api/leads**: Captures RFQ, computes AI intent score, prices lead ($85–$250), and matches top operators.
- **POST /api/bookings/deposit**: Locks in 15% concierge escrow deposit, assigns vetted fleet, and generates official receipt (`BK-REL-2026-XXXX`).
- **GET /api/operator/wallet?operator_id=...**: Retrieves operator balance, live territory RFQ feed, and transaction history.
- **POST /api/operator/wallet/topup**: Adds prepaid balance credits ($250 / $500 / $1000) with bonus credits.
- **POST /api/operator/leads/unlock**: Deducts $85 and unmasks customer contact details with replacement guarantee.
- **POST /api/financing/apply**: Evaluates commercial equipment loan eligibility and projects Section 179 tax deductions.
- **GET /api/growth/verify-badge-backlink/:vendorId**: Crawls vendor website to verify embedded trust badge and unlocks 15% lead discount.

---

## 3. Programmatic Knowledge Silos & pSEO Ontologies

### A. Municipal Permit & OSHA Compliance Guides (`/permits/[slug]`)
- **OSHA Standards Grounding**: 29 CFR 1926.51(f) minimum 1 facility per 20 workers for job sites > 200 persons; ANSI/PSAI standards for special events (1 unit per 75-100 attendees for events > 4 hours).
- **Interactive JS Feasibility Engine**: Dynamic client-side calculation of required stations, graywater storage capacity (gal), and power draw (20A/110V dedicated circuits).
- **Structured Data**: Complete `FAQPage` JSON-LD schema on each municipal guide.

### B. Best-in-City Fleet Leaderboards (`/best/[slug]`)
- **Vetted Spec Comparison**: Side-by-side matrices comparing Station Count, ADA Compliance, A/C & Heating, Onboard Freshwater, and Verified Trust Scores.
- **Structured Data**: Validated Schema.org `ItemList` with embedded `LocalBusiness` and `AggregateRating` schemas.

### C. National Corporate Rental Alternatives (`/vs/[slug]`)
- `/vs/united-rentals-alternative`: Direct independent fleet operator dispatch vs. national broker call centers.
- `/vs/sunbelt-rentals-alternative`: Transparent upfront quotes without surprise freight or post-event environmental fees.
- `/vs/national-broker-alternative`: Guaranteed fleet reservation escrow with 48-hour free cancellation.

---

## 4. Institutional Fleet Vetting & Logistics Standards

- **Underwriting Framework**: Strict third-party verification for commercial equipment operators.
- **Coverage**: All 50 major US Metropolitan Statistical Areas (MSAs).
- **Compliance Matrix**:
  1. **Commercial Electrical & Shore Power Verification**: Multi-circuit 110V/20A dedicated line validation and Tier-4 sound-attenuated generator compliance.
  2. **Subsurface & Grade Feasibility**: Ground-bearing and access-route assessment for heavy-equipment deployment.
  3. **Environmental Health Compliance**: Certified electronic blackwater and graywater disposal manifests at municipal wastewater facilities.

---

## 5. Viral Reciprocal Trust Badge & Verification Protocol

- **Official Badge Vector**: `https://www.reliantverified.com/badges/verified-2026.svg`
- **Partner Incentives**: Embedding badge on operator site unlocks 30 Days Free Featured Rank ($99 value) and a permanent 15% discount on all RFQ lead unlocks.
- **Verification Hook**: `GET /api/growth/verify-badge-backlink/:vendorId` validates reciprocal backlink status and updates operator wallet state in real-time.
